# Outpatient Infusion Services

Our Outpatient Services department at Benewah Community Hospital provides a full range of interventions for patients who do not require hospitalization but need to receive treatments on a regular or infrequent basis.

Our services include, but are not limited to:

  * Chemotherapy services
  * Blood Transfusions
  * IV/IM Antibiotics
  * IV Iron Therapy
  * Port flushes
  * PICC line and Central line care (dressings and flushes)
  * IV Hydration Therapy
  * IV Autoimmune Disease Treatments (Arthritis, Lupus)
  * Treatments for Multiple Sclerosis
  * Treatments for Osteoporosis and other Bone Diseases
  * Negative Pressure Wound Therapy (vacuum assisted closure) dressing changes

Our convenient location is on the second floor at Benewah Community Hospital, right here in St. Maries. We are staffed with experienced, highly trained, compassionate nurses.

We are available for scheduled appointments Monday – Friday from 8:00am – 4:00pm. Please call our referral line, 208-245-7670 for after hour and weekend availability.

# Chemotherapy & Outpatient Infusion Services

Benewah Community Hospital offers Chemotherapy & Outpatient Infusion services right here in St. Maries. Debbie Pritchard, RN and Janis Worch, RN who share a combined 46 years of nursing experience provide care for you in your local community.

Our Chemotherapy and Outpatient Department provides a warm and friendly place for Chemotherapy treatments, and a wide variety of conditions including:

Partial List of Conditions

  * Multiple Sclerosis
  * CIDP
  * Crohn’s Disease
  * Immune Deficiency
  * Rheumatoid Arthritis
  * Infectious Disease
  * Ulcerative Colitis
  * Lupus

Referrals from outside Physicians are accepted! For more information, please call (208) 245-7670 or talk with your Provider. *Most insurances accepted upon pre-authorization. *

5MW Photography

## Nicole's Bio

 Nicole has been involved in the horse world since a young age and has continued to be an equine and animal enthusiast. She started out taking horseback riding lessons at 7 years old. Nicole rode competitively with her horse Brody before taking on her nursing career in Pennsylvania. She had also taken up the love for teaching horseback riding lessons while going to nursing school.

  After nine years as an Emergency Room Nurse, she’s now shifting her focus back to what she loves most—working with animals while still working as a nurse.

Image: IMG_9570_edited.jpg

Image: Untitled design-6.png

5MW Photography

5MW Photography

## Who inspired canine PEMF?  "Roxie"

This is Roxie. Though she’s no longer with us, she had a profound impact on Nicole’s passion for helping other canines. Diagnosed with osteosarcoma, Roxie faced amputation, chemotherapy, physical therapy, and ongoing vet care—all with an incredible attitude and strong spirit. She beat the odds, surviving two years beyond her diagnosis and never missed a beat!

Seeing Roxie’s journey inspired Nicole to wish she’d had access to PEMF therapy to support pain, inflammation, and healing. Roxie’s story is a major reason Nicole now wants to offer this resource to other dogs in the community.

# Home Infusion Support

## Healing at Home with Confidence

St. Luke’s offers patients the option of managing their infusions in their own homes, when appropriate for their treatment needs. This includes therapies such as antibiotics, hydration, chemotherapy, and total parenteral nutrition (feeding through an IV line). We also provide support for enteral feeding services (nutrition delivered through a tube to the stomach or the small intestine), specialty infusions for chronic conditions and other standard medication infusions.

Home infusion support is staffed by expert pharmacists, nurses, dietitians, and pharmacy and dietetic technicians. Your medications will be delivered by St. Luke’s local pharmacy, and you may choose whether to receive home infusion education, support and guidance in your home or at a home infusion support clinic. Our top priority is ensuring your care is meets your needs.

Contact the St. Luke’s Pharmacy – Home Infusion Support team at (208) 381-6161 for more information.

### We are committed to exceptional quality, safety, and care through every step of your infusion.

**Acknowledgment of potential risks and variability in Results**  
I understand that while many individuals experience benefits from PEMF therapy, results may vary. The effects of PEMF are influenced by various factors, including the individual's condition, frequency of sessions, and overall response to therapy. Possible temporary side effects may include, but are not limited to, increased detoxification symptoms (i.e., mild headache or dizziness, temporary soreness, mild fatigue, or minor skin irritation at the application site).
